name: Ward Stevens Automotive
reviews: They'll recommend what needs/should be done but will not pressure you into anything.

Very polite and knowledgeable! Got my car back quickly and everything was done to perfection. Prices are great and didn't get pestered about air filters or other misc stuff. Very comprehensive inspection report.

Dropped my truck off for an oil change and ended up getting a full inspection. They took the time to send me photos of issues AND included information on whether they were a priority fix, or something to keep an eye on. No pressure- just honest, hard work to keep me informed.

The guys hooked up their scanner and found the problem. Everything was out of timing with the computer. So they were able to rest it to the proper settings. Yay I give them the highest mark possible for their skills.
